name: opencode-proxy
description: The OpenCode proxy layer (opencodeProfile) on top of the generic core-proxy engine
author: intisy

scripts.build: npm --prefix core-proxy/core-ir install && npm --prefix core-proxy/core-ir run build && npm --prefix core-ir install && npm --prefix core-ir run build && npm --prefix anthropic-translator install && npm --prefix anthropic-translator run build && node core-proxy/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir core-proxy/java --module :teavm --out core-proxy/src/generated/core-proxy.teavm.js && npx tsc --project core-proxy/tsconfig.json --types node && node core-proxy/copy-generated.mjs --root core-proxy && npx tsc && npx esbuild src/frontdoor.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/frontdoor.mjs && node scripts/postbuild-deploy.mjs
